baseline: Current line smoother and CUDA graphs. Eager controls disable K-cycle and hierarchy refresh graph capture.
candidate: FP64 CPU SuperLU of the live FP32 coarse stencil, with one direct correction at the last level.
residual_history: The first FGMRES linear solve starts from the same case state. True scaled residuals are stored as [cumulative iterations, L2 residual] after each restart block; block endpoints can occur at different iterations.
timing: Serial fresh processes; synchronized public solve wall time, excluding input construction and the independent physical audit. Head comparisons are outside the timing.
memory: Peak RSS covers the complete process through the independent audit. Warp CUDA pool peak excludes allocations outside the pool. Estimated LU bytes include factor values and indices and exclude work arrays and metadata.
physical_acceptance: All reported endpoints passed the independent NPF physical audit. Pairwise head differences use the specified graph solve as the reference.
